name: Starwood Preferred Guest Business Credit Card from American Express
notes: Historical Starwood Preferred Guest Business record. The issuer Cardmember Agreement as of 09/30/2018 names Starwood Business Card and American Express National Bank; its rewards supplement explicitly names Starwood Preferred Guest Business Credit Card. Lifecycle (checked 2026-10-21): American Express's own business travel-card comparison page, archived 2019-01-11, lists the Starwood Preferred Guest® Business Credit Card with a "$0 intro annual fee for the first year, then $95"; the same page archived 2019-03-11 lists the Marriott Bonvoy Business™ Card in that slot instead, so the SPG Business product was withdrawn and replaced by us-amex-marriott-bonvoy-business between those captures. The annual fee ($95, $0 first year) is taken from the 2019-01-11 capture. The joint American Express/Marriott press release of 2019-01-23 (republished by Hospitality Net, secondary source) dates the rebrand to February 13, 2019; that date is not on an issuer-domain page that could be retrieved, so discontinued_date is left unset. Other financial fields remain unverified. Card art provenance (checked 2026-10-21, secondary source, lower confidence): no usable official issuer image was found, so this is a local upload under the repo's option-C convention (image.provenance.source "other"; the sha256 is of the downloaded file). The image URL is listed in secondary_sources. Match: purple 'spg Starwood Preferred Guest BUSINESS' American Express face from NerdWallet's 2019 card listing (archived 2019-07-22), the pre-Marriott-Bonvoy SPG Business design. The artwork remains the copyright of the issuer; it is for identification only and is not evidence of lifecycle or financial fields.
